description: Quote the Chainlink CCIP fee for bridging USDC across the 3-chain triangle (eth/avax/arbitrum). Returns BOTH the LINK fee (~10% cheaper) and the native fee, so the agent can pick the cheaper path or surface both options to the user. Read-only; no auth required.

amount.description: USDC amount in raw 6-decimal units (e.g. '1000000' = 1 USDC). Integer string only.

destReceiver.description: Destination receiver (0x 20-byte address). Same EOA on the destination chain.

dst.description: Destination chain (MUST differ from src; pool only routes inside the 3-chain triangle).

name: q402_bridge_quote
